lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere laalan kee sobhaa ||
lines.translation: O, the Wondrous Glory of my Beloved!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨ ਮਨ ਰੰਗੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sad navatan man ra(n)gee sobhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind is rejuvenated forever by His Wondrous Love. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)draa bhagat daan jas ma(n)gee ||1||
lines.translation: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra beg for the charity of His Praise and devotion to Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਤਰੰਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog giaan dhiaan sekhanaagai sagal japahi tara(n)gee ||
lines.translation: Yogis, spiritual teachers, meditators and the thousand-headed serpent all meditate on the Waves of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)tan balihaarai jo prabh ke sad sa(n)gee ||2||3||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Saints, who are the Eternal Companions of God. ||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: terai maan har har maan ||
lines.translation: Belief in You, Lord, brings honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੇ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nain bain sravan suneeai a(n)g a(n)ge sukh praan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: To see with my eyes, and hear with my ears - every limb and fiber of my being, and my breath of life are in bliss. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਮੇਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: it ut dah dis ravio mer tinahi samaan ||1||
lines.translation: Here and there, and in the ten directions You are pervading, in the mountain and the blade of grass. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ਤਤ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat kataa tat pekheeai har purakh pat paradhaan ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, the Supreme Lord, the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g bhram bhai mite kathe naanak braham giaan ||2||1||4||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, doubt and fear are dispelled. Nanak speaks the Wisdom of God. ||2||1||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਬੇਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun naad dhun ana(n)d bed ||
lines.translation: The Glory of God is the Sound-current of the Naad, the Celestial Music of Bliss, and the Wisdom of the Vedas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathat sunat mun janaa mil sa(n)t ma(n)dalee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Speaking and listening, the silent sages and humble beings join together, in the Realm of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਮਨ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan maan daan man rasik rasan naam japat tah paap kha(n)dalee ||1||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom, meditation, faith and charity are there; their minds savor the Taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting it, sins are destroyed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਤਤ ਬੇਤੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਅਖੰਡਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog jugat giaan bhugat surat sabad tat bete jap tap akha(n)dalee ||
lines.translation: This is the technology of Yoga, spiritual wisdom, devotion, intuitive knowledge of the Shabad, certain knowledge of the Essence of Reality, chanting and unbroken intensive meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਛੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਡੰਡਲੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ot pot mil jot naanak kachhoo dukh na da(n)dalee ||2||2||5||
lines.translation: Through and through, O Nanak, merging into the Light, you shall never again suffer pain and punishment. ||2||2||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun bidh taa kee kahaa karau ||
lines.translation: What should I do, and how should I do it?

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਗਿਆ ਅਜਰ ਪਦੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharat dhiaan giaan sasatragiaa ajar pad kaise jarau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Should I center myself in meditation, or study the spiritual wisdom of the Shaastras? How can I endure this unendurable state? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bisan mahes sidh mun i(n)draa kai dar saran parau ||1||
lines.translation: Vishnu, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - at whose door should I seek sanctuary? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo pahi raaj kaahoo pahi suragaa kot madhe mukat kahau ||
lines.translation: Some have power and influence, and some are blessed with heavenly paradise, but out of millions, will anyone find liberation?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak naam ras paaeeai saadhoo charan gahau ||2||3||6||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have attained the Sublime Essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I touch the feet of the Holy. ||2||3||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanapat daiaal purakh prabh sakhe ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Breath of Life, the Merciful Primal Lord God, is my Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: garabh jon kal kaal jaal dukh binaasan har rakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord saves us from the womb of reincarnation and the noose of death in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; He takes away our pain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhaaree saran teree ||
lines.translation: I enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prabh daiaal tek meree ||1||
lines.translation: O Merciful Lord God, You are my only Support. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਆਸਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaath deen aasava(n)t ||
lines.translation: You are the only Hope of the helpless, the meek and the poor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam suaamee manahi ma(n)t ||2||
lines.translation: Your Name, O my Lord and Master, is the Mantra of the mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh binaa prabh kichhoo na jaanoo ||
lines.translation: I know of nothing except You, God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jug mahi tum pachhaanoo ||3||
lines.translation: Throughout all the ages, I realize You. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: har man base nis baasaro ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You dwell in my mind night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਰੋ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d naanak aasaro ||4||4||7||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is Nanak's only Support. ||4||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan jaapeeai bhagavaan ||
lines.translation: Within my mind and body I meditate on the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore suprasa(n)n bhae sadaa sookh kaliaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru is pleased and satisfied; I am blessed with eternal peace and happiness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kaaraj sidh bhae gaai gun gupaal ||
lines.translation: All affairs are successfuly resolved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਨਾਠਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhasa(n)gat prabhoo simare naathiaa dukh kaal ||1||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I dwell upon God, and the pain of death is taken away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh meriaa karau din rain sev ||
lines.translation: Please take pity on me, O my God, that I may serve You day and night.
